fields.name: plateReads
fields.basis: the live vendor exposes a plate-read family; a generated record carries none, because a plate read is a surveillance record about an identifiable person and a demo fixture pack does not carry one

fields.name: personsOfInterest
fields.basis: the live vendor exposes a persons-of-interest family; a generated record carries none, for the same reason as plateReads and with the same force

fields.name: occupancyCount
fields.basis: a granted feed carries a counted occupancy; a generated record carries a band only, because a specific head count is a specific claim about a specific place at a specific moment

fields.name: operatorName
fields.basis: a granted feed carries the driver name; a generated record carries an opaque operator reference only, because a fixture must not name a person

notRegistered.shippedBasis: Basis: neither job is a registered region, so the surface does not exist. A registered region with no source says something else, and the patrol roster above is saying it.
notRegistered.shippedJobsBasis: copied from web/index.html at this ref: the two jobs the Police lens itself names as not regions on this product

shipped.lede: Cameras and the patrol roster. Each region states its own source, and the roster is the one region in this product that is BUILT with no source at all, which is a different sentence from a region that does not exist.
shipped.cameraParagraph: Devices, the sites they group under, and how each one is reporting. No plate read and no person of interest is carried here: those are surveillance records about identifiable people, and the record contract declares both as fields a generated record never has.
shipped.patrolParagraph: This region is BUILT. It declares a record shape, it carries a working generator, and its tiles are the instrument it ships with. What it does not have on this pack is a source, and that is what the basis below says. Nothing is drawn to fill the space and the tiles stay unread rather than showing a zero, because a zero would be a claim about a fleet nobody has read.
shipped.notBuiltParagraph: Two more Police jobs are named on the live city roster and are not regions on this product yet. They are listed rather than hidden, so the lens never implies coverage it does not have.
shipped.notBuiltBasis: Basis: neither job is a registered region, so the surface does not exist. A registered region with no source says something else, and the patrol roster above is saying it.
shipped.occupancyCaption: A band, never a head count
shipped.sitesCaption: An opaque site reference, never an address
shipped.sourcedRuleTemplate: a region is sourced when its kind is granted on this pack and it returned records
shipped.vendorLiveVerifiedHeader: TWO OF FIVE ARE HONESTLY UNAVAILABLE TODAY, NOT BROKEN. Live-verified 2026-09-03: Samsara, Spireon and PowerBI return real data. FirstDue returns a real, specific 403 (the source route's own code already documents this: current API credentials lack apparatus/assets scope, contact dashboards@firstarriving.com). GoTo returns "not authorized" (needsAuth: true) -- the OAuth consent flow (GET /api/goto/authorize) has never been completed by a human. Neither is a code defect; both need a real-world action outside engineering. This module reports whichever state is genuinely true each time it's called, not a cached assumption.
shipped.vendorLiveSpireonClause: Live-verified 2026-09-03: Samsara, Spireon and PowerBI return real data.
